texts.content:
Westfield Animal Shelter — Volunteer Application

Name: ____________   Phone: ____________
Email: ____________
Age: ____ (Volunteers under 16 must come with a parent.)

Which jobs interest you? (check all that apply)
☐ Walking dogs (morning or afternoon)
☐ Cleaning cages and feeding animals
☐ Helping at weekend adoption events
☐ Office work (answering phones, filing)
☐ Other: ____________

Availability: ☐ Weekdays ☐ Weekends

All new volunteers must attend one two-hour training session before their first shift. Sessions are held on the first Saturday of each month at 9 A.M. Return this form to the front desk or email it to help@westfieldshelter.org. We will contact you within one week.

questions.stem: What must every new volunteer do before starting?
options: C. Bring a parent to the shelter
D. Work at a weekend event
questions.explanation: "All new volunteers must attend one two-hour training session before their first shift."

questions.stem: What is indicated about volunteers who are 14 years old?
options: B. They must be accompanied by an adult.
C. They may only do office work.
D. They can only volunteer on weekdays.
questions.explanation: "Volunteers under 16 must come with a parent."

questions.stem: What is suggested about the form?
options: A. It is only for people with office experience.
B. It must be returned by mail.
C. Applicants may choose more than one type of job.
D. Applicants must be available every weekend.
questions.explanation: The jobs section says "(check all that apply)," so applicants can select several jobs.
